response: Nirvana, the influential American rock band, was formed in Aberdeen, Washington, in 1987. The band was founded by lead singer and guitarist Kurt Cobain and bassist Krist Novoselic. Drummer Dave Grohl joined the band in 1990, replacing Chad Channing who was the original drummer. Nirvana is best known for helping to popularize grunge music and for their breakthrough album "Nevermind" released in 1991.
